nodes.dlaczego_ja.text.t: "You were the first to survive something that killed everyone else. I didn't choose you: I found you. At first it was only practicality. Then... I don't know. Attachment is a mistake that people make faster than we do."

nodes.prawda.text.t: "The truth. Good. I'm one of those who flew here to build a home, not a war. My people stayed behind in a world that closed after us, and the Core was the only thing that could open it again. I tried to get it for a long time, longer than the Emperor has kept his pact. The Emperor had a pact. I had patience." She falls silent. "I'm no better than he is. I'm only more tired."

nodes.rozmowa.options.[prawda].text.t: Tell me the truth about yourself.

nodes.rozmowa.options.[ton_przetarg].tex.t: You spoke of bargaining. What would the price of an end be?

nodes.rozmowa.options.[ton_wyrok].text.t: I promised you that your kind wouldn't go back where you flew from. I've come to keep that promise.

nodes.rozmowa.options.[ton_wyrok_s].text.t: I promised you that your kind wouldn't go back where you flew from. I left you a door. Don't ask why.

nodes.rozmowa.options.[ton_zwloka].text.t: I promised to finish what's left. This is the last of it.

nodes.rozmowa.text.t: The Being waits. Her hands rest loose at her sides, as if she'd forgotten what they were for.

nodes.ton_przetarg.text.t: "Instalments. Bargains. Everything I did was bargaining, even when I healed. But there's nothing left to trade. The last instalment is me."

nodes.ton_wyrok.text.t: "I remember. I took it the way one takes a sentence from a distant country. Do what you've set down. I'll only allow myself to stop pretending I'm not afraid."

nodes.ton_wyrok_s.text.t: "I'm not asking. I'll remember that it was your decision, and not my request. That's a rare thing too." Her hands rise slowly, and the stars in them light up as if they knew what to do.

nodes.ton_zwloka.text.t: "The things that were left to finish. I'm one of them, aren't I? I won't pretend I don't see it."

nodes.walka.text.t: The Being holds her hands out in front of her, and the stars in her transparent palms light up one after another. "By all means," she says, as if inviting you to the table.

nodes.wojna.text.t: "The war was a means, not an end. The Hetman wanted to be great, so he got powder. The Emperor wanted to be safe, so he got a guard. Not from me. They both got what they asked for. Nobody asked what others would get out of it."

nodes.wstep.text.t: The black glass you took for her face lies beside her on the floor like a helmet taken off. Without it the Being is shorter than you remember from those nights. The skin of her face is transparent as glass, and beneath it, where people have bones, slow stars circle. The islanders call her Szklanna, and the name stuck. She speaks quietly, without anger, with the weariness that comes after a long goodbye. "I know why you've come. Let me finish one sentence, and then we do what has to be done. The debt is paid. What you do now, you do for yourself."
